summary: Retain passive-repair probe controls and refuse its obsolete native entry point.
details: The F210/F200 passive-repair host probe still requires direct-library conversion and stops before staging or engine use. Its historical enabled/default-off and reload scenarios remain preserved.
Retained tiny-file controls cover input identity, resource budgets and failure behavior. They do not authorize the old staging path or establish current native passive-repair acceptance.
